# Logo assets

The documentation and README use the Python palette and MCP overlay from
the libtmux asset kit. `libtmux.svg` is the vector mark; `libtmux.png` is
its transparent 512px fallback. Both sidebar themes use the same mark.

`icons/` contains the browser and mobile icons listed in
`../../manifest.json`, Apple touch artwork, and the Safari mask.
`../favicon.ico` contains the ICO fallback. `opengraph.png` is the
1200 × 630 social card; `twitter.png` is the 1200 × 600 card. The repository
social preview at `../../../.github/social-preview.png` uses the same MCP
artwork as `opengraph.png`.

The geometry comes from the project owner’s libtmux and tmuxp SVGs. The palette
uses [GitHub Linguist’s Python color](https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/blob/538da05f034fa5c83bd81df128d144e208898da3/lib/linguist/languages.yml).
The overlay uses the symbol from the [MCP logo](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/088176704a4e8f20e7f1d237de1de8484aa412fd/docs/logo/light.svg).
